abstract: Underwater wireless sensor network(UWSN) is an emerging technology for exploring and research inside the ocean. Since it is somehow similar to the normal wireless network, which uses radio signals for communication purposes, while UWSN uses acoustic for communication between nodes inside the ocean and sink nodes. Due to unattended areas and the vulnerability of acoustic medium, UWNS are more prone to various malicious attacks like Sybil attack, Black-hole attack, Wormhole attack, etc. This paper analyzes blackhole attacks in UWSN and proposes an algorithm to mitigate blackhole attacks by forming clusters of nodes and selecting coordinator nodes from each cluster to identify the presence of blackholes in its cluster. We used public-key cryptography and the challenge-response method to authenticate and verify nodes.

articleTitle: The Cost-Effective Secure and Privacy-preserving Navigation System
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The increasing consumption of the services of secure and privacy-preserving navigation system gradually demands the cost-effective navigation system to assist the On-board Unit(OBU) to reach the destination in the optimal time period. In this paper we provide the cost-effective privacy-preserving navigation system by removing the malicious Road-side Unit(RSU) at first without revealing the destination information the RSU so that the time required for the communication in the navigation will be reduced. The proposed work mainly deals with the computation time taken for the communication and the comparison among all the recently proposed schemes shows that the proposed work in terms of the reduces the time complexity by 11.291%.It is proven to be resistant to various cryptographic attacks like Anonymity, Replay Attack, Man -in-Middle Attack, unlinkability, Impersonation attack, Information Leakage. The BAN logic is used to authenticate the freshness and trustworthiness of the message. The simulation for the proposed work is done using SPAN, the Security Protocol Animator for AVISPA for CL-AtSe backend and MIRACL library 5.6.1 is used to implement number theoretic based methods of cryptography.

articleTitle: Bengali Functional Sentence Classification through Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the early time, very few studies were accomplished in Bengali functional sentences. However, the study on Bengali has incredibly increased for its structural diversity. Inspired by those studies, Functional sentence classification in Bengali language was completed including machine learning approaches to classify the sentences. Three types of Bengali functional sentences such as Assertive, Interrogative and Exclamatory have been considered for the research. So the leading purpose of the study is to classify the sentence and find out the best algorithm with comparing accuracy rate. Data have been collected, categorized and processed the dataset properly to avoid the conflict. Some popular machine learning algorithms such as Naive Bayes (NB), Decision Tree Classifier (DT), SVM, KNN, Random Forest (RF), and XGB Classifier have been implemented to compare accuracy rates. Parameters such as Precision, Recall, F1-Score, Support and Confusion matrix have been calculated for the comparison. The comparison demonstrated that performance of the Random Forest, SVC, and XGB Classifier is better than Naive Bayes and Decision Tree Classifier. Remarkable issue is that the Random Forest algorithm provided the highest performance value with an accuracy of 75.38% which is average performance for such a dataset.

articleTitle: An Alternative Route-Finding Technique to Bypass Localities Affected by Communicable Diseases
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The extreme pandemic has changed the traveling habit as people are skeptical about traveling through the infection outbreak regions. Therefore, it has become a need to find alternative routes whenever traveling in a city kind of regions. In the current paper, we have proposed a simple yet smart system for predicting the safest route between source and destination amongst other alternative routes. The safest route is with minimum exposure to localities affected by the spread of communicable diseases like COVID-19. It is done by considering different quality measures assuming that there will be available information on the active number of infection cases from the governing authorities. However, the only information taken into account is the location of the confirmed active cases without using any other sensitive information of the patients. The proposed system will help common people while traveling in the pandemic situation. It will also be helpful for the local administration in restricting movement to and from containment zones.

articleTitle: Exam Preparation KIT Using Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Assessments are an important aspect of academics to monitor an individual's performance but they are often observed to cause unnecessary stress among students. Insufficient knowledge of exam patterns and expectations from students often lead to the students not expending their energy in the right direction. Moreover in an overpopulated world, it is impossible for an instructor to give one-on-one guidance to the students to ensure they are on the right track and to gauge their readiness for assessments. To overcome these challenges, this paper presents a Natural Language Processing based exam preparation kit acting as a complete guide to better equip students for the exam. This kit displays questions and assesses the students based on their response and awards marks as per the expected answer. The system tracks strong and weak areas of the student and assists in improving their performance. A sentence BERT model was finalised and used to implement the system after comparing various ways and reported a root mean squared error of 7.026734661% and standard deviation of 6.493339783%.

articleTitle: Investigation of EEG Signals for Emotion Recognition of People for Brain-Computer Interface
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: EEG-based emotion recognition has recently been taken a large space for several applications that are related to brain-computer interface. Machine learning algorithms make this process easier. This paper investigates how the EEG signals are changed with eight different classes of emotions, namely joy, relax, sad, fear, sleepy, calm, happy, and excited. The EEG dataset provided by ‘DEAP’ has been used for this purpose. The raw data is preprocessed, then some features are extracted using PCA technique, and finally, these features are used for classification purposes using CNN, SVM, KNN, AdaBoost, NB, and RF classifiers for different emotional states. An average accuracy of 99.84%, 98.06%, 98.98% for valence, and 99.53%, 97.89%, 98.51% for arousal states are respectively obtained for CNN, SVM, and RF classifiers. Besides the accuracies of 96.86%, 98.13%, 98.20% for dominance, and 98.61%, 98.28%, 98.20% for liking states are respectively obtained for CNN, SVM, and RF classifiers. Among all the mentioned classifiers CNN provides a better classification accuracy on an average of 99.68% comparing with SVM and RF in valence and arousal states.

articleTitle: An Immunoinformation Approach of B-Cell Epitope Prediction of Osteoclast-Associated Immunoglobulin-Like Receptor
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Osteoclast is such a type of bone cell which is responsible for bone resorption. Osteoclast-associated immunoglobulin-like receptor is a leukocyte receptor complex member as well as a pivotal molecule in the mechanism of osteoclastogenesis which is responsible for osteoclast. As it is threatening for bone purposes; vaccination can be a convenient technique to refrain from the issue. In this recent study, several types of immunoinformatics pathways were wielded to detect efficient B-cell epitopes of human Osteoclast-associated immunoglobulin-like receptors. For the exploration of this, the physicochemical properties, transmembrane region of the human osteoclast-associated immunoglobulin-like receptor were also analyzed. The homology 3D model of the human osteoclast-associated immunoglobulin-like receptor was also developed. Graphical epitopes of B-cell were analyzed by conducting BCPREDS, BepiPred, ABCpred as well as Bcepred. After analyzing the outcomes were validated through surface accessibility, antigenicity, flexibility as well as linear epitope prediction. After analyzing the epitopes some of the accessible B-cell three-dimensional models had been built. This study analysis also disclosed that the most accessible B-cell epitopes are “WGPGVWSPSLVALPGPVVG”, “QRSEVLV”, “FKPGELA”, “YRRPDWGPGVWSQPSPGEIAPLLFRDVSS ELAE”, “REGV AAPL YRHSAQP”, “GVWSQPS”, “PGEIAPL LFRDVSSELAE” as well as “TEELPRPSL” This study analysis can be very helpful for further analysis as well as for the vaccine designation in the realm of osteoclast diagnosis.

articleTitle: Optimizing Recurrent Neural Network Using Neuromodulation
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Over the past years, there has been a rapid pace in the field of technology. It is fostering itself at an ever-rising rate and machine learning is a part of this entire revolution. Technology is moving closer and closer as machines are taught how to learn and grow on their own. With seamless evolution in engineering advancements, machines are more enduring gradually, manageable, and consistently exhibiting better results. Although these techniques are achieving new highs, all of them still lack the continuity of past activities and carry them forward with new novel activities, similar to how the human - brain performs. To unleash the limitations of current neural networks and design a better approach like the brain a neuromodulation technique is applied to differentiable plasticity. In this method, we will embrace meta-learning through memorization and reconstruction of the novel images. Consequently, we are comparing the task with other previously existing neural techniques to evaluate the performance. Rooting out the limitations of gradient explosion, vanishing gradients, and time the complexities of training LSTM models. We conclude that neuromodulation on differentiable plasticity is a compelling framework for complex neural networks.

articleTitle: Neuromorphic computing: Modelling of 3D integrated circuit components using TSV
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Over the years transistor size is reduced such that now we are on the edge of Moore's law. To overcome this problem and to feed the need of better processors, multichip packaging (3D) technologies have evolved as well as new approach of computer architectures, complimentry to existing one, have developed. A major component of 3D IC is Through Silicon Via. Through-silicon vias (TSVs) directly connects die-to-die stacked structures. In the process parasitics of the IC is also changed. In this paper, a TSV structure is generated and analyzed in HFSS with a view to understand its parasitics. And the same is compared to interconnects used in equivalent 2D IC. ITRS roadmap provides standardization in silicon dimensions. Following these standards, a model of TSV is generated and simulated in HFSS to analyze, measure impact of TSV on capasitance, inductance, resistace as well as crosstalk. High density, effectively packed silicon devices can be manufactured using TSV technique. In Neuromorphic computing (NC), processing and storing of data is done at the same place. NC plays key role in making faster processors for next generations of computers as well as in making of dedicated hardware for ML, AI applications. The paper mentions possiblities of use of TSV to creat dedicated Neuromorphic components and its effect.

articleTitle: Social Media Intelligence for Brand Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the rise of social media users, the amount of data being generated every day from the social media websites is increasing. Social media web sites like Instagram, Twitter, Snapchat, etc. are allowing the users to express their opinions on any subject and share their opinion with people sitting in any corner of the world. Numerous posts are also posted about various brands belonging to multiple domains like technology, sports, fashion, etc. These posts, when analysed, can provide valuable insights about the social media users' opinion and prove to be an untapped gold mine for the brands. These insights can in turn help the brands to make better business decisions based on the insights that are extracted from the posts. This paper aims to provide a real-time solution to stream the tweets from Twitter related to a specific brand and analyse them in real-time in order to extract insights from the tweet data that allows the brands to know what exactly are the social media users' perceptions about them. This solution consists of multiple stages where scripts are deployed on servers and run around the clock to process the raw streamed tweet data using artificial intelligence techniques in order to extract location, sentiments, named entities, date and time to further categorise the information based on numerous factors mentioned in the paper and present the data in the form of charts displayed on a webpage which will enable the end user to gain insights and uncover hidden patterns from the data.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Trust Model for Cloud Service Provider Selection with NLP Support and Malicious User Feedback Filtering
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the rapid development of Cloud Computing and the increase in Cloud Service Providers(Csp),there is an immense rise in the cloud services provided to the users. With a mass choice of CSPs, trust has become a major concern for both CSPs and the Cloud Service Users(CSU). It plays an important role in evaluating cloud services and helps in the robust selection of CSPs without compromising security, performance, and privacy. Research has been done in this field that talks about one-way trust between CSPs and CSUs but little to no work has been done which includes bi-directional trust in the same model. We propose a Trust model for cloud service selection that considers the bi-directional trust i.e., trust based on user requirements and user feedback, making it more reliable in real-life scenarios. An NLP approach that extracts requirement values from both text and numerical input and a Malicious Feedback Filtering Mechanism are proposed.

articleTitle: A DWT and Coefficient Exchange Block Based DCT Image Watermarking and their Comparative Assessment
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the cyber world to protect any product of human intellect from the unauthorized user one of the most widely used security technique i.e., digital watermarking comes into play. This paper produces a detailed comparative analysis between DCT and wavelet-based watermarking technique based on different watermarking evaluation parameter. The exhaustive comparison begins with embedding a watermark into all three different level frequency coefficients of DCT technique based on the coefficient exchange method and evaluates their performance against many common attacks. All four sub-bands of 1 level of DWT are considered for embedding a watermark. The paper also emphasized JPEG based comparison between selected bands of two approaches on various quality factors (QF). The best band are selected from these two techniques for further contrastive analysis using measuring matrices like PSNR and NCC. Experimental results and simulation of the system are based on the MATLAB tool. Different graphs and observation tables are also explained in this process to clearly visualize the comparison results.

articleTitle: B-Cell Epitope Prediction of Osteoclast-Stimulatory Transmembrane Protein Using an In Silico Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Osteoclast-stimulatory transmembrane protein (OC-STAMP) is the responsible protein for osteoclast. Since it poses a danger to bone health, vaccination can be a successful way to prevent the issue. Several immunoinformatics pathways were applied in this recent study analysis to detect effective B-cell epitopes of human OC-STAMP. The physicochemical properties, as well as the transmembrane region of the human osteoclast-stimulatory transmembrane protein, were investigated. The human OC-STAMP homology 3D model was also developed. B-cell graphical epitopes were investigated resorting to BCPREDS, BepiPred, ABCpred, as well as Bcepred. Surface usability, antigenicity, as well as bepipred graphical epitope enumeration were used to verify the results after they were analyzed. Any of the available B-cell three-dimensional models were developed after the epitopes were analyzed. The most convenient B-cell epitopes, according to this research, are “LLSCLLRLLGLLALLLVATAVAVATDHVAFLLAQA”,“VATVCGLLVFLSLGLPPVRCLFALSVP”,“TQRLAQAQATHLLAPPPTWLLQAAQLRLSQEE”. In thefield of osteoclast diagnosis, this study analysis may be veryuseful for future research as well as vaccine designation

articleTitle: A hybrid approach for feature selection based on global and local optimization for email spam detection
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: These days, Due to the universal availability of internet connections, email correspondence has become one of the most cost-effective and efficient approaches for official and business users. Millions of spam emails are being shared every day. To protect individuals or organizational data, Spam detection is needed. In Spam detection, handling high dimensional datasets in machine learning is high in time complexity and space complexity. To decrease time complexity and space complexity, feature selection is required to remove the irrelevant features. In this paper, the proposed idea is to optimize the feature selection method to decrease time complexity, space complexity and increase accuracy as well. The proposed feature selection method is a hybrid method based upon two optimization techniques; the first one is global optimization using the chi<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> selectkbest method, The second one is local optimization using the Tree-based feature selection method. Experiments are carried out to compare four different classifiers. The proposed idea performs well on precision, memory, and accuracy efficiency tests, according to the findings.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Prediction with Gaussian Process Using Anthropometric Parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In recent years, the breast cancer classification has piqued attention in the area of health-care informatics which is the second leading cause of mortality in women due to cancer. The spread of Breast Cancer growth and its high casualty has prodded a ton of research for contemplating its causes and medicines. The enormous number of genes and their entwining relations requires progressed AI models, instead of simple statistical and correlation analysis. Having the objective to propel the present status of knowledge concerning the early determination of breast cancer, we utilized Random Forest (RF), Logistic Regression(LR), Support Vector Machine(SVM), and Gaussian Process(GP) classifiers, joined with testing unique and novel biomarkers. This paper presents a correlation of these Machine Learning (ML) algorithms by estimating their order test exactness, and their sensitivity and specificity esteem. For the execution of the ML calculations, the dataset was divided into 80% for the training phase, and 20% for the testing phase. Results show that Gaussian Process performed well with 90% test exactness on the order task.

articleTitle: A Review of In Band Full Duplex Communication in 5G Cellular Network
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: To fulfill the extremely high demand of user and data traffic, most important features in 5G communication systems is Radio frequency spectrum. To satisfy the service requirements from various applications, more spectrum is needed or same spectrum should be used efficiently. In Band Full Duplex (IBFD) communication can transmit & receives the data at same time & using the same frequency. IBFD with proper deployment will double the spectrum efficiency & hence capacity, which will be the highest achievement in this digital era but the major hurdle is mitigating the self-interference (SI). This paper gives brief idea about different technique used to cancel the SI at different stages of signal processing & even through physical & MAC layer frame structure. This paper also discussed the collaboration of IBFD in spectrum sensing environment along with tradeoff involved in adopting FD Communication. Because of the substantial advantages of FD communication, this study field has got a lot of interest from the scientific community.

articleTitle: A crosstalk-aware and energy-saving survivable RSCA for online prioritized traffic in SDM-EONs
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Inter-core crosstalk due to the presence of multiple cores is one of the major issues to be taken care of in space division multiplexing based elastic optical networks (SDM-EONs). Again due to the random occurrence of spectral fragmentations in online SDM-EON, many high-priority connections get blocked. The underlying SDM-EON also suffers from ample data loss even if a single link in the network fails. Survivability is ensured in this paper by using multipath based approach. Again, survivability issue deserves enough redundancy in the network devices which again increases energy consumption in the network. Multipath based survivability is used in this paper. To address the aforementioned issues simultaneously, this paper proposes a novel energy-efficient and crosstalk-aware multipath based survivable routing, spectrum and core allocation scheme ECM-P-RSCA, for prioritized traffic in online SDM-EONs. Extensive simulation results prove the efficacy of ECM-P-RSCA over a non-prioritized similar scheme in terms of various network parameters such as bandwidth blocking, energy consumption, spectral occupation rate, crosstalk generated per slot ratio etc. It is also observed that with increase in number of cores in SDM-EON, crosstalk per slot ratio increases.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Microfinance and its impact on Human Development indicators using the instance of Kerala's Kudumbashree Model
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Human development refers to enhancing the richness of human lives to ensure that they enjoy healthier, longer, and more meaningful lives. This paper examined how MFIs (Microfinance Institutions) influenced the Human Development Index (HDI) using the Kudumbashree model in Kerala, India. This report critically analyzed the impact of MFIs on the three primary human development variables - income, education, and women empowerment. This critical analysis enabled the researcher to conclude, using the instance of the Kudumbashree model, that MFIs positively influence human development indicators, and apart from increasing income and savings levels, it has also enabled its female members to become empowered and also ensured that they have access to adequate educational programs and skill-training schemes.

articleTitle: ICon: How Can We Intelligently Predict TCP Congestion?
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: To enhance the wireless network performance, several new wireless standards, such as IEEE 802.11ac/ax, are introduced, where the objective is to increase the throughput in the network. However, Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) congestion degrades the network performance due to limited network capacity. The standard congestion control mechanism focuses primarily on acknowledgment (ACK) packets, which may result in inappropriate handling of congestion, and lead to the increase in packet drop rate and packet transmission delay. As a consequence, overall network efficiency is degraded. In this paper, we propose Intelligent Congestion control (ICon), a learning-based congestion control mechanism, that uses Deep Neural Network (DNN) to smartly predict the occurrence of congestion based on the present channel condition in the network and the last congestion window size (old window size). We use Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) as the measurement of channel condition, and thus the impact of signal quality on the volume of transmitted packet is implicitly introduced in the prediction of congestion in ICon. For the generation of the dataset to train the proposed DNN, an intensive simulation is used. Through simulation, we analyze the performance of ICon, where it is noted that the proposed scheme significantly improves overall network performance.

articleTitle: NPABT: Naming Pattern Analysis Of Bengali Text To Detect Various Community Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Natural Language processing is an important part of Artificial Intelligence which enriches languages. It creates a bridge between humans and machines to communicate. In this paper, we have proposed a method that can automatically predict a person's community where he may belong by using their name. Based on the research available on online literature, we are the first to do research on it. We have collected more than 8,000 names of the four major communities of Bangladesh, including both males and females. Then data has been preprocessed to clean those texts by following the natural language processing approach. The six most popular machine learning classifiers have been used to train and test this data. Usually, human names have some prefix or suffix of their community. From that prefix or suffix, this method determines the community of that person's or their predecessors' community. The used approaches worked really well for these data and give higher accuracy for the models. The total performance of those classifiers is up to 65.12%-78.25%. Random Forest (RF) classifiers achieved the highest accuracy which is 78.25%.

articleTitle: Faster Region Based Convolutional Neural Network and VGG 16 for Multi-Class Tyre Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper intends to create a deep-learning architecture for training models over various defective tyre images until it has achieved intelligence to distinctly classify multi-class tyre defects and tell apart various types of defects in tyres using computer vision. This paper aims to create a system that can detect defects and allow professionals to spend more time trying to find a fix for it instead of spending time diagnosing it. It wishes to provide an automated Inspection system that is both reliant and fast with improved business sustainability at a lower cost. The models will be created and compared using Faster R-CNN and VGG16, the two architectures of ConvNets primarily used to perform computer vision tasks like recognition, classifications. We performed the multi-class tyre defect detection using a self-made dataset consisting of 970 images.

articleTitle: Advancement of Quantum Methods in Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Quantum principal component analysis (QPCA) is analogous to the classical method with additive speedup. This is based on the unsupervised dimensionality reduction mechanism that transforms exponentially high dimensional data points into low dimensional space by retaining significant features with the largest variance. To our knowledge, quantum computations are highly exponential and supports implicit parallelism. Therefore, quantum method for finding principal components are proved to achieve exponential speedup over existing classical solution. An advantage of quantum superposition is utilized for the Eigen decomposition of density matrix which is identical to covariance, however, a way through which its computation happen, is truly an interesting factor. This paper presents basic methodological framework to design QPCA algorithm. Our framework includes the methods for quantum data encoding, quantum memory processing, and the requisite quantum circuit implementations to realize QPCA algorithms. In addition, we categorized existing QPCA methods in view of recent advances. We then proposed the possible advancements that can benefit to design quantum based efficient algorithms for principal component analysis. At the last, suggested concepts are compared with existing methods based on complexities and other factors to justify our proposal as significant in perspective to future directions.

articleTitle: Low Cost and Modular Approach to Real-Time Vehicle to Vehicle Communication using Wi-Fi
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the modern era, data sharing is a predominant aspect of electronic and telemetry communications. The same concept is being expanded to the automotive industry as connected vehicles, to facilitate road safety and driver assistance. Vehicle to Vehicle (V2V) connectivity is mainly aimed towards avoiding the possibilities of road accidents by providing necessary alerts like lane change warning, pedestrian crossing warning, intersection collision warning, etc. This paper aims at providing a low-cost and modular approach to V2V communication using WiFi for certain constrained traffic scenarios. It utilizes a low-power single-board computing unit with modular hardware to attain the same. It facilitates a range of data transmissions like images, videos, and alert messages making it a flexible approach under short range and limited device connectivity constraints. Our experiments and test scenarios show that for similar real-life conditions, this method could provide a cheap and effective alternative to existing V2V communications.

articleTitle: Sybil Attack Simulation and Mitigation in UnetStack
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Underwater networks have the potential to enable unexplored applications and to enhance our ability to observe and predict the ocean. Underwater acoustic sensor networks (UASNs) are often deployed in unprecedented and hostile waters and face many security threats. Applications based on UASNs such as coastal defense, pollution monitoring, assisted navigation to name a few, require secure communication. A new set of communication protocols and cooperative coordination algorithms have been proposed to enable collaborative monitoring tasks. However, such protocols overlook security as a key performance indicator. Spoofing, altering, or replaying routing information can affect the entire network, making UASN vulnerable to routing attacks such as selective forwarding, sinkhole attack, Sybil attack, acknowledgement spoofing and HELLO flood attack. The lack of security against such threats is startling if maintained that security is indeed an important requirement in many emerging civilian and military applications. In this work, we look at one of the most prevalent attacks among UASNs which is Sybill attack and discuss mitigation approaches for it. Then, feasibly implemented the attack in UnetStack3 to simulate real-life scenario.

articleTitle: Emotion Detection Using Bi-directional LSTM with an Effective Text Pre-processing Method
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In a real-life scenario, extracting emotion from unstructured text is an active and challenging area of research. It has diverse applications in various aspects of our daily life To overcome various challenges involved in detecting emotion from text, researchers from diverse fields applied various machine learning algorithms. However, deep learning methods such as long short-term memory is effective to detect emotion by maintaining the sequence structure of the text. In this work, we use Bi-directional long short-term memory with attention layer for emotion detection for better accuracy for prediction. In addition, we employ a text preprocessing method to improve further results. We perform the experiments on three data sets and the models are evaluated based on the classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Concept Drift and Model Decay Detection using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Machine learning mainly focuses on building applications that can automatically learn periodically and improve their working experience without being explicitly programmed again. Data extracted from dynamic distributions for real-world applications lead to a phenomenon called concept drift. This hitch could encounter when the dependency and relationship of the input data features and class variable varies gradually. So, the model must be capable of processing this data and swiftly adapt to these changes. In this context, we opt for an unsupervised approach, which uses a sliding window mechanism to detect drift in the concept by analyzing the variations in the distribution of the new samples. It uses a classifier that does not have any inbuilt drift detection and adoption mechanism. Experimentation is done on various drift detectors using several data sets. The performance of our method comparatively is higher than D3, Adwin, Page-Hinkley, and OCDD methods.

articleTitle: Credit Card Fraud Detection with Resampling Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With the advancement of technology and consumer strength, the use of credit cards has rapidly increased. Credit Cards have shortened a transaction process making it simpler but has made the system prone to frauds. The information regarding one's credit card can easily be stolen and misused. Due to a gazillion data points of transactions available with the banks, Machine learning and Deep Learning Algorithms may prove very helpful in finding patterns and preventing fraudulent transactions. This paper is focused on delivering a comparative study on various supervised machine learning algorithm's performance for identifying fraudulent transactions by handling a highly imbalanced data-set by applying sampling techniques and work with a new approach in solving the problem for better results.

articleTitle: A Data Mining Approach to Identify Human Behavior on Different Activities of Student
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Human behavior involves a broad range of behaviors cultural elements, arrogances, feelings, values, integrity, consultant, rapport, hypnosis, influence, coercion, and heredity. The use of social media is quickly increasing at the moment. The situation is much more concerning for those users who share personal information on multiple social media platforms. Their actions can be seen on social media. We explored several human behavior activities on social media in this our research paper. To ensure the validity of the acquired data, we applied 10-fold cross-validation and presented the results in the form of a performance matrix. Finally, we have used three classifier's algorithms to identify the best result for this research. The final result reflects the validity and quality of the obtained data, as well as the accuracy and efficiency with which a model to study the causes of human behavior changes have been built. We have applied 3 different algorithms (Multilayer Perceptron, Random Forest, and AdaBoostM1), where we have gotten best accuracy from 99.20% by using AdaBoostM1 algorithm and 99.70% from Multilayer Perceptron and 99.60% by using Random Forest algorithm.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approach to Predict Influence of Smoking on Student Life
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Smoking is one of the measure factors to distract student life, also a leading factor for many diseases in the recent era, where many university students take this habit as a fashion. In Bangladesh, 35% of grown-ups are now consuming tobacco either smoked and/or in smokeless form according to a World Health Organization report. This is because our study to find out the reason behind it and the consequence of smoking on graduate student's life. This study focused on different attributes of student life to find out the impacts of smoking in their academic life. We got most of the students who used to do smoke did not get better results in their academic life. As a result, they cannot be able to build their desire future. However, we tested many algorithms, wefound the same accuracy of two algorithms those are KNN and random forest. We got 87.93% of accuracy from applying those two algorithms from our collected dataset.

articleTitle: Detox: NLP Based Classification And Euphemistic Text Substitution For Toxic Comments
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The challenges of eliminating inadvertent hate online have grown more and more observable. With rapid increase in access to technology worldwide, the number of people present on the internet has increased exponentially. The rise in hateful and toxic content on the internet is many fold. Present solutions are largely based on censorship and removal of such content and can be the cause of mental disturbance to the concerned auditor. Biases of manual moderation can thwart the efforts taken to prevent the presence of hate speech on online platforms. However, posts that convey important meanings also fall prey to such systems, which should be avoided. Such systems fail to educate their authors what should have been done differently. Additionally, a system that combines detection and substitution algorithms is largely absent. A euphemistic substitution approach could prove to be more effective. In this project we have developed a classifier using Natural Language Processing and Machine Learning to detect toxic texts and provide euphemisms to erudite the user of words that can replace the toxicity present in the original texts. The classifier informs the online platform about the toxicity of the texts so they restrict such content to available on its platform. The euphemisms are aimed to make the user aware of the toxicity in the text and suggest replacements, which, if used, can make the text inoffensive. We aim to achieve self realisation on the user's part so we can target the issue at its source.

articleTitle: Decentralized Cloud Storage using Unutilized Storage in PC
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cloud Storage is emerging tremendously. Cloud Storage service is provided as an Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS). We can access the data stored in the cloud whenever and wherever we want it. Cloud Storage providers require high resources to maintain the storage servers in their data centres. Nowadays in most of our personal computers (PCs), we find a lot of storage space left unused and we have good internet connectivity. So, our idea is to use our PCs as storage servers by storing the data in the unutilized storage space. We also focus on the security of the data. So, along with some practices followed by the existing cloud storage services, we implement some additional methods to protect the data in our decentralized cloud storage model.

articleTitle: Design of a Low-Power One-Sided Schmitt-Trigger Based 13T SRAM Bitcell
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This study describes the design of a novel 13-transistor (13T) Static Random Access Memory (SRAM) bitcell that employs a single bitline design with isolated transistors used for write and read operation. The bitcell incorporates Schmitt- Trigger based inverters, resulting in a considerable rise in cell's static noise margin. A power gating approach is also used to increase the bitcell's write capabilities, resulting in reduced power consumption during write operations. The proposed bitcell was designed using a 0.18μm technology in Cadence Virtuoso Software. The various performance parameters like stability, Power Consumption, Delay and Leakage power are compared against the conventional 6T SRAM bitcell. Overall, the proposed 13T SRAM bitcell outperforms the conventional 6T SRAM cell in every aspect.

articleTitle: Top-Down analysis based performance failure bucketing for Pre-Silicon simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Integration of high-end features in core microarchitecture of CPU plays a key role in meeting performance expectations in the industry. However, it also brings challenges to the Pre-Silicon Performance Validation team in uncovering deep-seated performance issues within the core. Performance bucketing of hardware failures is a difficult task due to the absence of an error signature, unlike its functional counterpart. This poses a challenge in terms of man-hours required to do the precise categorization of failures over a huge database of tests. The proposed solution is based on a Top-Down Microarchitecture Analysis (TMA) approach, which can predict a core pipeline unit responsible for maximum IPC difference between RTL and reference model in Pre-Silicon. It uses Performance-Monitors (PMONs) available in core hardware, whose accuracy is validated by dedicated teams in Pre-Silicon and Post-Silicon, and when used in TMA can help the Performance Validation team to triage the failures quickly and accurately.

articleTitle: Implementation of Topology Independent Loop Free Alternate with Segment Routing Traffic
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Network failures have a huge impact on daily life and its restoration must be done at the earliest. The slow convergence time of configured routing protocols during the link failure becomes a concern and to overcome this problem various Fast Reroute (FRR) mechanisms are developed. FRR's key feature is fast failure detection and pre-calculation of an alternative path even before link or node fails. This precalculated alternative path bypasses the problem and restores communication in the event of a true network failure. In this paper Topology Independent Loop-free Alternate (TI-LFA), a Fast Re-route (FRR) technique is implemented with Segment Routing (SR). This implementation is carried out by creating different network topologies using CISCO IOS XRv routers in Cisco virtual lab environment. Firstly, the created topologies are configured with an IGP protocol, in this case it is configured with IS-IS protocol for routing functionality. This is followed by configuration of segment routing and TI-LFA on each of the individual routers. TI-LFA functionality is implemented for zero, single and double segment scenarios using different network topologies and it is verified by the labels imposed in each scenario. Shared Risk Link Group (SRLG) protection is also implemented and verified with the help of routing information base.

articleTitle: SIW Cavity-Backed Pentagonal Slot Antenna For X-Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, a rectangular cavity-backed antenna using substrate integrated waveguide technology is presented. A pentagonal slot with stubs etched on the top surface is excited by a 50 Ω microstrip line present on the bottom surface. The stubs help to bring a new mode into the X-band frequency range, thereby greatly improving the bandwidth of the antenna. The antenna operates in the frequency range 9.54-12.25 GHz with a gain of 7.8 dB at 10.08 GHz and an impedance bandwidth of 26.83%. The antenna exhibits a reflection coefficient of -21.26 dB at 10.08 GHz and a front-to-back ratio of 36.46 dB. The designed structure is compact, easy to fabricate and can be integrated into planar devices for practical X-band applications.

articleTitle: Understanding and Evaluating Commonsense Reasoning in Transformer-based Architectures
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Ascertaining the reason for and identifying the differences between sensical and nonsensical statements is a task that humans are naturally adept at. NLP methods, however, might struggle with such a task. This paper aims to evaluate various transformer-based architectures on common sense validation and explanation task, methods to improve their performance, as well as interpreting how fine-tuned language models perform such tasks, using the attention distribution of sentences at inference time. The tasks entail identifying the nonsensical statement from a given pair of similar statements (validation), followed by selecting the correct reason for its nonsensical nature(explanation). An accuracy of83.90 and 88.42 is achieved on the respective tasks, using RoBERTa (large) language model fine-tuned on the data sets using the ULMFiT training approach.

articleTitle: The Current State of Prescriptions and Potential Enhancements Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: E-prescription is an essential need to address fallacies of paper-based prescription. E-prescription system could benefit from blockchain technology immensely. Blockchains' decentralized architecture promotes greater reach and economy of implementation. This paper attempt to understand the potential of blockchain in enhancing e-prescription systems and identify required improvements for a potential e-prescription design. In this paper, the existing issues of the prescription system are identified. A basic understanding of e-prescriptions and blockchain technology with relevant applications is provided. Recent works on blockchain-based e-prescriptions are analysed for identifying the required enhancements needed. A potential e-prescription system design is feasible based on the identified improvements mitigating existing prescription issues.

articleTitle: Impact of Modulation and Coding Schemes on VoLTE Call Blocking in Cellular LTE Network
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Voice over LTE (VoLTE) has emerged as the mainstream voice service over cellular Long Term Evolution (LTE) network. It is observed that this VoLTE service often gets blocked during call initiation or during handoff due to insufficient radio resources. In this regard, we have presented a Physical Resource Block (PRB) based Markovian model to estimate VoLTE call blocking in cellular LTE network. Using this model we have investigated the impact of different modulation and coding schemes on call blocking in cellular LTE network providing VoLTE service.

articleTitle: Greenness Visualization in Al-Ain using Landsat Imagery
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Analyzing the greenness level is the method used to identify the ground vegetation cover. It plays an important role in providing data about the soil moisture and fertility in different areas and the effect of regional climate change. The key factors for this type of analysis are the land and the soil of the area of vegetation, in which they have a great effect on the growth of different types of vegetation depending on the type of crop and the area of interest; along with these key factors, environmental factors such as temperature and precipitation (moisture) values are required to have a clear image of the required areas in the analysis. The analysis is acquired through remote sensing provided by the LANDSAT series. The analysis of this paper is based on the images of Al-Ain obtained from LANDSAT 8 and is achieved by utilizing short wave infrared sensors through earth engines.

articleTitle: A Novel Smart Hospital for Isolation of COVID-19 Patients
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper we describe a smart and innovative system which provides prime contribution to our society in this pandemic situation. We propose a novel smart hospital with multi featured equipments along with fashionable isolation ward for COVID-19 patients. A website interface has been proposed under anyone can visit and after knowing the status of the beds either for the isolation or emergency ward they can easily book from remote location. A QR code with registration number will be provided to the users. These users may reach to the hospital and have to pass through the QR code scanner for verification and sanitization process. A pre-evaluation section has been defined where proper mask at face will be detected with thermal scanner facility. All the designed section is controlled and monitor by control unit through server. Well featured with multiple sensors a unique ward is designed where oxygen level sensor is used to sense the level of oxygen and if the level of oxygen of patient is less than defined value supply of oxygen will switch on the supply automatically. Doctor will monitor and take care of patients through CCTV and video conferencing. The entire sub design unit is controlled and monitored via hybrid network and IoT.

articleTitle: Loss Optimised Video Captioning using Deep-Lstm,Attention Mechanism and Weighted Loss Metrices
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The aim of the video captioning task is to use multiple natural-language sentences to define video content. Photographic, graphical, and auditory data are all used in the videos. Our goal is to investigate and recognize the video's visual features, as well as to create a caption so that anyone can get the video's information within a second. Despite the fact, that phase encoder-decoder models have made significant progress, but it still needs many improvements. In the present work, we enhanced the top-down architecture using Bahdanau Attention, Deep-Long Short-Term Memory (Deep-LSTM) and weighted loss function. VGG16 is used to extract the features from the frames. To understand the actions in the video, Deep-Lstmis paired with an attention system. On the MSVD dataset, we analysed the efficiency of our model, which indicates a major improvement over the other state-of-art model.

articleTitle: Recognizing Human Actions in Video using Motion History Image and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Action recognition from videos has become one of the coveted fields in recent years because of its potential applications. In particular, action recognition methods utilizing deep learning are found to be effective. In this paper we use spatio-temporal context of videos to recognize the actions in videos using motion history images. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated on a new dataset with typical payment related actions.

articleTitle: Crop Suggestion using Data Mining Approaches
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A solution using Association Rule Mining and Clustering is proposed where, given the conditions, a farmer will be suggested the suitable crop(s) that he can cultivate based on the past years' data. The implementation was done using Apriori, Frequent Pattern Growth (FP Growth) and K-Means algorithm. Data Mining techniques used prove to be very useful in helping the farmers in growing the suitable crops.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Multilayer Patch Antenna for IRNSS, GPS, Wi-Fi, Satellite, and Mobile Networks Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The paper discuses a Nobel design of a multilayer patch antenna with multiband applications such as GPS, IRNSS, and 4G cellular networks. The design aspects and simulation of a right hand circularly polarized, multi-band, two-layer stack microstrip antenna for IRNSS, GPS, Wi-Fi, Satellite, and Mobile Networks Communications operating on L-band and S-band frequencies. The structure is design using High frequency structure simulator (HFSS) software. The antenna with a dimension of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$100\times 100\times 4.75\text{mm}^{3}$</tex> is integrated on substrate with undeflected ground plane at bottom. Both the patches consist of metal surfaces, and ROGERS RT/DUROID-5880(tm) with 2.2 dielectric constant and FR4 EPOXY with 4.4 dielectric constant is used as a substrate material. The given multilayer design has been evaluated based on various properties and parameters corresponding to Return loss, VSWR, Radiation pattern, Electric field, Magnetic field and Gain.

articleTitle: Design of a Low-Cost Wearable Heart and Respiratory Rate Measurement Device Using an Arduino and Bluetooth Module
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The respiratory rate (RR) as well as the heart rate (HR) are two of the main vital signs that show how well a person's body is performing. The heart rate is defined as the number of times a person's heart beats in one minute, whereas the respiratory rate is defined as the number of times a person breathes in one minute (breaths per minute). Measurement of heart rate and respiratory rate often indicates a person's health condition and may identify any cardiovascular or respiratory illness. Existing wearable health smart devices are expensive and are often inaccurate. The objective of this manuscript is to develop a cheap, high-accuracy wearable heart rate and respiration rate monitoring system. A photoplethysmography (PPG) based heart rate monitor, and chest motion-based respiratory rate monitor has been used here. For the PPG-based heart rate monitor, we designed an efficient and accurate heartbeat sensor circuit. For the respiratory rate monitor, we used the concept of chest motion during exhalation and inhalation of air during the breathing process to design a chest belt module to measure a person's breathing activity. The prototype of these measurement devices was then tested on multiple test volunteers for evaluating the system's performance at various conditions. The materials used for designing this system and its performance make the device a cost-effective and reliable alternative to existing wearable smart health devices. The amount of breath completed per 60 seconds is known as the respiratory rate. When an individual is steady, the rate is typically calculated by calculating the number of breaths taken in one minute and noting the amount of times the chest rises. Fever, sickness, and other medical conditions will cause you to breathe faster. In the current situation of COVID-19, it is very necessary to check the respiratory rate to check the patient's current health status. Therefore, our project will be helpful for the COVID patients also.

articleTitle: A Computer-Aided System for the Detection and Segmentation of Lung Nodules Using Mask R -CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Computed Tomography (CT) of the chest is one of the most instrumental tools used in the screening of lung carcinoma and is the most prevalent non-invasive modality used for the localization and characterization of lesions found in the lung tissue. In this paper, we propose a computer-aided approach for the detection and segmentation of lung nodules. The publicly available LIDC-IDRI dataset has been leveraged to obtain CT images in the axial plane. Furthermore, the generated data is used to train a Mask R-CNN, one of the most effective instance segmentation models available, using a multi-step training strategy. Finally, we validate our methods by computing the average precision and the Jaccard Index.

articleTitle: Drowsiness Detection From Real-Time Video Capturing Using Convolution Neural Network and Low Frequency Sound
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today's rushing and technological world, folks do not give much importance to health which is causing a severe impact on our efficiency of doing work. Insomnia due to fatigue is one of the major problems people are facing in today's world which causes several negative impacts. One of which is accidents due to drowsiness of the motor drivers and due to this concern, the project is designed to build an effective and efficient drowsiness detection system, the main purpose of this paper is to develop a model to analyze the face and the eye movement of the driver and detect drowsiness using convolution neural network (CCN). The model is also created to analyze different algorithms. It was found that using facial landmark detection algorithms, eyes and face components can be detected easily. The system will track the eye laces of the driver and produce a low frequency[4] sound alert when the driver feels drowsy.

articleTitle: Performance Measurement of Multiple Supervised Learning Algorithms for Gender Identification from Bengali Names
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Gender recognition of names is today regarded as one of the most significant problems in data extraction. Machine learning and NLP are used to solve this. Recognition of the gender of a name relies heavily on various kinds of NLP applications such as Question addressing systems, Text summarization etc. Throughout this article, we will investigate the Bengali name entity and attempt to extract and recognize the Person's name entity to determine if the name is male or female. Most people's names have a sexual orientation refinement. However, determining genders from Bengali names with greater accuracy might be difficult. We will demonstrate an artificial intelligence-based characterization technique that can accurately determine sexual orientations from Bengali names. We'll use a variety of algorithms to figure out which computations get the best results. We attained an accuracy of 84 percent by using Naive Bayes.

articleTitle: Sickle cell anemia detection using convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sickle cell anemia (SCA) is a genetic condition caused by a mutation in one of the genes that produces hemoglobin. This causes the otherwise circular RBCs to become sickle shaped and obstruct the blood vessels. Sickle Cell disease (SCD) deteriorates the oxygen supply to different parts of the body and leads to severe anemia. Although SCD is not curable, patient's life expectancy and quality can be improved if the disease is diagnosed early and a proper medication and care is made available. Hence precise detection and classification of blood cells is important. Manual classification is tedious and requires expertise. Automatic classification using image processing and machine learning is feature dependent, inefficient and sensitive to change in color, shape and size of the blood cells. Hence this research proposes the use of deep neural network to detect the existence of sickle-shaped cells in blood samples so that a precise diagnosis of the disease can be done. Here RBCs are classified in one of the three classes: Normal, sickle shaped and other blood components. Histogram equalization is used for preprocessing and data augmentation technique is used to tackle the shortage of dataset. We achieved a testing accuracy of 94.57% with a CNN consisting of only 5 convolution layers.

articleTitle: FoodByte: An Android Based Mobile Health Application for Taking Dietary Decisions
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Dietary decisions can help people to make a healthier lifestyle. We can observe and measure our daily diet data and make conclusions based upon them. Food pigments have been linked to various beneficial health effects in the human body. This paper presents an android based mobile health application named FoodByte to track people's diets. The goal is to collect daily dietary consumption meal images using a mobile camera and keep the data to a remote server so later it can be used to analyze. Based on the data of images and user's feedback of different questionnaires research was conducted to find the effects of food pigments on human health. Here we compared four dominant colors and showed that the overall healthiness of the meal is reflected by the dominant color. Our research shows that yellow and red color foods are best rated for taste whereas brown color foods are considered to cause bloating and gassiness. On the other hand, foods with red and yellow colors are the reason behind indigestion and heartburn can occur due to red color food. According to the results, it is clear that the foods that are yellow are the least harmful and good for health with an average value of 1.6. However, the ANOV A result indicates that after taking meal gas is considered to be statistically significant with a p-value of 0.0375.

articleTitle: Implementation of Segment Routing-Traffic Engineering over MPLS
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Segment routing (SR) is a path-based routing strategy that makes traffic engineering and network management easier and is the most versatile method of path routing. In this paper, Segment Routing - Traffic Engineering (SR- TE) offers a simple, automated, and scalable architecture for engineering traffic flows in a network using explicit and dynamic path policies. The topology is built using CISCO IOS-XRv routers in Cisco Modeling Labs. The SR Path Computation Element (SR-PCE) built on IOS-XRv also fits into the topology. SR PCE includes multi-domain path disjoints as well as scalable multi-domain SR optimized path computation capabilities, in a distributed or centralized control environment. This allows to have a full control over the traffic. Whenever the network situation changes, the dynamic path policies such as IGP metric, TE Metric, HopCount Metric and Latency Metric are introduced in the network topology and the path is recomputed and implemented automatically, under these policy conditions an effective and better scalability performance is achieved.

articleTitle: Handwritten Text Recognition for Non-Latin Languages using Deep Learning - Bangla
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Language aims to have effective handwritten recognition which purpose is writer involvement on written documents concerned with the Non-Latin language in Bangla. In the Non-Latin language, Bangla claims the necessity of Auto-Learned Features with a sufficient manner supported by Human Constructed Features. According to this problem assertion of handwritten documents, security is sought for the proposal of document identification. In a sense, the Bangla language has a large vocabulary where it renders so many complex words including compound characters. On account of the Bangl.a language, usable boundaries are large because of the volume of manpower. Therefore, handwritten documents arise a great number a couple of times. Addressing those features of the problem proposed a model with CNN where it outperformed the handwritten documents in Bangla that mixed with different writers wrote the same documents in a different way. Moreover, the SVM comparison strongly stated that CNN is an effective approach on account of 70% training and 30% testing validation concern with 83%.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of A Multiple Input and Multiple Output Antenna for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: With a frequency of 2.45 GHz, this paper presents the design of a multiple input and multiple output (MIMO) antenna for Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) applications. The performance of two distinct designs of a 2.45GHz antenna for unmanned aerial vehicle was evaluated in this paper. In the field of communication, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) play a crucial role. Reliability and high data rate are needed for an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV)-based communication system. As a result, multiple input and multiple output (MIMO) antennas were used to boost the data throughput and dependability. The basic structure of this antenna is a rectangular patch. The two designs were done. The first one is a Q-slot antenna with a full ground plane, while the second is two Q-slot antennas with a full ground plane and an isolator is added between the two Q-slot antennas. The center frequency of all the designs was 2. 45GHz. The MIMO antennas presented have a 0.06GHz bandwidth and a return loss below -10 dB, in accordance with S specifications (S11) The single Q-slot antenna and the proposed MIMO antennas achieved maximum gain of-1dB and-2dB, while the radiation efficiency was respectively 19.39% and 16.08%. Computer simulation technology (CST) was used to design the antenna. A return loss curve was observed for both designs. In terms of center frequency and efficiency, both designs show similar results but the bandwidth and maximum gain are increases slightly differing.

articleTitle: A Comparative Review on Cooling Techniques to Develop Hybrid PV/T Panel
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Renewable energy will be the leading source of power on the upcoming days. Solar irradiation is one of the most convenient sources due to abundance in nature. Right now scientist are facing challenges to mitigate the heat induced by the solar panel during the conversion process. Excessive heat degrades the electrical property of photovoltaic panel thus resulting in reduced efficiency. To improve the efficiency different cooling techniques have been introduced namely active and passive cooling. It is really important to select the right cooling technique while developing the PV panel. It is found that, passive cooling technique is more preferable in-terms of operating cost, ease of use and reliability.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Combined Approach of Zero Finding Logic and Operand Decomposition in Systolic Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease is the major threat to human life for decades and deaths do occur due to delayed treatment. In order to prevent this disease, ECG analysis should be done at the earliest. Detection of QRS complex detection is the predominant step in ECG analysis. Implementation of such detection algorithms requires dedicated hardware. Hardware realizations can be done using VLSI technology. VLSI technology had played a decisive role in the field in signal processing. In designing a VLSI system high speed, low area and low power consumption are the fundamental metrics to be considered. Generally design of adders and multipliers will have constraints in delay, area and speed. This paper addresses to design area and delayed reduced systolic filter for the application of QRS detection algorithm. Systolic Filter design is built by Zero finding logic in adders and operand decomposition method in multipliers. All the circuits were designed using Modelsim and implemented in Xilinx Spartan 3S family for analysis. The implementation result shows that proposed architecture provides the combinational path delay reduction of 15%, 31%, 20% for 4-tap, 8-tap, 16-tap Systolic filter structure and area reduction of 20% when compared with the existing filters.

articleTitle: Livestockly: An Application for Providing Veterinary Services
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Ensuring pet/livestock's health is need of an hour. In some situations immediate accessibility to hospital is tough for pet owners/farmers (for example: current COVID-19 situation),in such cases there's a need to provide virtual treatment to animals. An application named Livestockly is developed using Flutter and data is stored using Firebase. This application is simple and easy to use and useful for distant areas. Affiliation with Government bodies can be claimed by providing Farmer's code(Saatbara code) to the system.

articleTitle: Mitigation of Electromagnetic Interference in high speed circuits
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, we have put forward, a unique 3D layer methodology for a crisp and broadband electromagnetic band-gap structure (EBG) to be used in high-speed printed circuit boards (PCBs). In high speed circuits there exists issues of signal integrity and power integrity and is very important to minimize them for efficiently transmitting data at high speeds. Using this technique we have effectively converted one dimensional EBG structure into a vertical 3 dimensional structure, therefore substantially reducing the EBG area and also reducing the space between the unwanted sound origin and the area affected by the same.

articleTitle: Dependency of routing protocol on pH and SNR in Underwater Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Underwater communication is very critical in today's world with the advent of IoT devices which require proper communication standards and protocols to be in place for improving performance. Routing protocols is one such important feature of underwater communications which helps devices pick the best route based on different parameters. In this paper we designed and implemented an On-Demand Routing protocol which uses pH of the water and the SNR to choose the best hop while forming a route in underwater communications. The effects of pH on SNR were studied and the various factors affecting pH were observed. A pH model was developed using the data collected from the Hawaiian Ocean Waters.The routing protocol was designed and implemented in UnetStack3 as well.

articleTitle: Associative datamining Survey on Modern Era People's engagement of Gaming addiction
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Game addiction means when we are addicted to a game too much and we are forgetting our normal daily activities like sleep, eating, study etc. This is a very common problem in our generation of people. This addiction is very harmful for our physical and mental health. So, this is going to be a very dangerous fact for our generation. It mainly influences our young generation. It can change our daily life. It hampers our study concentration, brain, health and we forget our social life for this addiction. Online game addicted people face lots of problems like headache, eye problem, eating problem, lack of sleep, losing mood easily etc. Nowadays, the collection of data via online is so difficult to do. When sending data collection forms to the friends, the relatives and others they feel uncomfortable sharing their personal information. So, we can't find any standard dataset for our research. Finally, we have decided to make our own dataset via collecting data from our friends, relatives and others. And we reserve our data in a systematic way, where the ML algorithm can classify our data in some categories. Therefore, the main purpose of this research study is to make sense about online game addiction and make a good structured and large data set for researchers which can help them to analyze the data and get applicable results from their research.

articleTitle: Innovative Game Based Educational Application for Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Video games, a multi-billion dollar industry is one of the most rapidly-growing industries in the world. With game-based learning becoming a growing trend among teachers and children to make play and learn go hand in hand. Researchers have demonstrated that games have the potential to create a learning environment for better achievement of educational and training goals. In this paper we study a game we have developed a game that teaches even a layman the basics of science, commerce, arts or any other respective field and life lessons. The main objective of our application is to make learning fun and competitive even for a layman. This application not only makes learning fun but also keeps the user engaged with learning by competing with friends in multiplayer mode. Multiplayer games have good market in gaming industry. Current educational games don't have consistent user base, the plan is to create a multiplayer mode which will keep the users engaged with the game on every day basis to learn new things about the respective fields they are interested in.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Inexact 3:2 Compressor-based Radix-4 Multiplier towards Image Multiplication
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, an inexact 3:2 compressor has been proposed. The proposed design has been used in radix-4 based 8×8 multiplier for the addition of intermediate partial products. Error parameters have been evaluated using MATLAB and compared with reported state-of-art designs. Meanwhile, the proposed 8×8 inexact multiplier has been providing an improvement of ~12% and 27% in the Error Rate (ER) and Normalized Mean Error Distance (NMED), respectively than its best counter-part reported. The proposed inexact design and some reported designs are designed in Cadence Spectre and their performance parameters (power, delay) have been evaluated using gpdk 45nm technology. The proposed multiplier architecture provides an improvement of 5% in power and 9% in delay than the best reported state-of-art design. Moreover, for the validation of the proposed inexact 3:2 compressor-based 8×8 multiplier, image multiplication has been performed in MATLAB. Mean square error (MSE), and peak signal to noise ratio (PSNR) are estimated to show the improvement.

articleTitle: Research on Heuristic Deployment and Scheduling Strategy of Cloud Resources Oriented to Cost Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In the context of cloud computing, the cloud service of computing resources has become a trend, but often due to various objective reasons, redundant cloud resources often cause waste of resources, leading to increased enterprise operating costs and reduced resource utilization. In response to this situation, this paper proposes a cost-optimized deployment and scheduling strategy for cloud resources combined with heuristic algorithms. The strategy first selects the initial deployment plan through the FFD algorithm, and then selects the most suitable server type for deployment of virtual machines based on the greedy algorithm for scheduling migration, and finally obtains the optimized cloud resource deployment scheduling method. Experimental results show that this strategy can reasonably plan and operate cloud resources and achieve a significant reduction in enterprise costs.

articleTitle: Modelling War Phenomena with an emphasis on Operation Research
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Different domains of mathematics and informatics have a great impact on a wide range of army needs. Mathematical models when formulated with appropriate parameters can determine an approximate state of war progress. Fields of operations research are of interest to military scientists primarily to recreate war phenomena inventory maintained, using simulations. This paper reviews basic war models such as Lanchester and Guerrilla models and proposes an inventory model with a practical simulation to demonstrate its applicability in modelling food inventory.

articleTitle: Word Sense Disambiguation for Large Documents Using Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
