We have compared the results of proposed approaches with some existing models and we found our proposed approach is able to provide better prediction performance.

articleTitle: ChainAccess: Blockchain based Web-Access through Biometrics
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The information process of each and every individual is dependent on the Digital Identity Management (DIM) system. To decrease the requirement of remembering multiple passwords and authenticate digital Identity with improved security, we propose an optimized solution by using distributed ledger technology and smart contracts for the DIM system, i.e., Blockchain. The smart contract ensures that the user's registration process occurs only once and the required details are securely shared to the websites with the user's consent. Compared to traditional and existing digital identity management systems, the proposed Blockchain-based Web-Access through Biometrics verification ensures the user's identity in one-time registration. It provides secure and easy access to respective websites.

articleTitle: A review on Weighted Association Rule Mining (WARM) Using Python Programming Language
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Association Rule data mining helps in identifying patterns in relational databases, transactional databases and other data repositories. It is considered an important technique in data mining. Its performance impacts the efficiency and effectiveness of data mining. This paper aims to understand the working of Association Rule Mining algorithms and implement Weighted Association Rule Mining algorithm with preassigned weights using Python Programming language. This code is not written in Python programming language till yet. Therefore, it is developed using python programming language. The code has been successfully tested and will certainly improve association rule data mining.

articleTitle: Do You Feel Me? Exploring Reception of Advertising Emotions by Consumers
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Social media platforms are used to measure the content popularity among the user based on their comments on the post content. Marketers often use these social media platforms to communicate with the audience and disseminate their marketing message in a most effective and efficient way. In this research, sports advertisement discussions have been extracted from Reddit and a sentiment analysis has been conducted on the message posted by an author and response received by the users. The study uses Python based algorithms for the analysis of the sentiments and to explore the emotional or sentimental relationship between authors ‘post and user’ comment and to understand the user comments behavior based on post sentiments.

articleTitle: Automatic Voice Synthesis System using Long Short-Term Memory and Google Mediapipe
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Lip reading is the process of visual speech recognition that has many applications in various fields. Among these applications, visual speech recognition is an essential task in communication for people who experience hearing disorders, or for those who have lost their voice due to damages to their vocal cords. To address these problems, advancements have been made in the field of machine learning to decode speech from human lip movements and promise patients a chance at restoring their communicative functions. This paper focuses on a visual speech recognition technique that first employs a facial landmark-based feature extraction method using Google's Mediapipe library, and subsequently trains a model using a Long-Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network. The library is used to capture 40 keypoints from each detected face and a single-layer LSTM network is used to train the model with these extracted features. The model achieved an accuracy of 86.5% on the test set, gathered from the Oxford-BBC Lip Reading in the Wild (LRW) dataset.

articleTitle: An Innovative Method for Identification of Artificially Ripened Banana Using Single Board Computer
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: A wide variety of fruits is explicitly identified, classified and even graded at different levels using computer vision based advanced image processing systems in these days. The fruits that are very rich in vitamins and minerals are rightly appropriate to have a long & healthy lifetime. In that way, a common and popular kind of fruit ‘banana’ is in good terms with nutritious value and price. On the flip side, the same variety is being forced to consume a lot of chemical substances (calcium carbide, acetylene and ethylene) during the process of ripening. In addition to that, all the on-going researches are focusing chiefly on certain shape, colour and size of the banana to detect its classification and maturity period. Considering the above-mentioned problems, this paper tries to sort out the differences that are lying behind the varieties of bananas related to the procedure of natural and artificial method for ripening with a great help of hybrid tool and during the process of study, the histogram value and the input of the sensor are obtained for threshold value along with the raspberry pi which is one of the single board computers. The proposed system gives around 94% of accuracy on detection of artificially ripen banana.

articleTitle: Ovarian Cancer Classification from Pathophysiological Complications using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Globally, ovarian cancer is the 8th most familiar malignancy in females. Ovarian cancer growth is generally analyzed at a late phase of the sickness. Obtaining a clinical point of view about any medical complications is needed to getting ovarian malignant growth early as there is no viable screening test for this malignancy and most cases are merely found in their severe stages. Ovarian cancer is generally found at a serious stage, the endurance rate is distinctive among the various sorts of ovarian threat. A progressing form explanation empowered the usage of pathophysiological complications to investigate ovarian harmful development earlier. In this paper, we evaluated the accuracy, precision, and recall estimation of a proposed framework utilizing machine learning techniques to predict ovarian cancer types (Non-Cancer, Ovarian Cancer, Peritoneal Cancer, Fallopian Tube Cancer, and Ovarian LMP) from patients' pathophysiological complications. Our proposed machine learning classifiers - support vector machine, random forest, and XGBoost achieved 71%, 72%, and 69% accuracy respectively.

articleTitle: Automated Paper Evaluation System for Subjective Handwritten Answers
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In order to automate the task of correcting handwritten subjective answers, we envision a system that reads such answers and grades them. In this project, we have created a mobile application to achieve this task. We have used the RAKE algorithm to extract key-phrases, which are then embedded using Word2vec model and compared using Word Mover's Distance. Our created model achieved almost human like evaluation accuracy. We have also provided accessibility features to the users with the aim of making this application a one-stop solution to automatic evaluation of handwritten subjective answers.

articleTitle: Comparison of Handcrafted and Deep Neural Network Feature Extraction for Recognizing Bangla Sign Digits Exploiting Machine Learning Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sign Language is the main communication medium for people who have a difficulty with speaking or hearing. To communicate with other deaf or healthy people, they use sign language. Deaf and mute people of Bangladesh and India use Bangla sign language to fulfill their communication needs. But, the learning process of sign language is time consuming and arduous. Therefore, as the artificial intelligence technology advances, automatic recognition of Bangla sign language is gaining more attention from researchers. In this paper, the proposed research aims to develop an approach to automate the identification of Bangla Sign Digits comparing the efficacy of handcrafted and deep neural network features. The handcrafted feature extractors like Histogram of Oriented Gradient (HOG), Scale invariant feature transform (SIFT), and pre-trained deep neural network feature extractors such as InceptionV3, Xception, and DenseNet-121 was used on publicly available Ishara-Lipi dataset to extract features. Moreover, to recognize sign digits, we used three fine-tuned classification algorithms namely K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM) that were fed by extracted features. Experimental result shows that the deep neural network features outperformed the handcrafted features based approach. DenseNet-121 combined with SVM based approach achieved highest test accuracy of 99.53% on Ishara-Lipi dataset.

articleTitle: Code Generator based on Voice Command for Multiple Programming Language
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this modern era, several new programming languages are introduced among the programmers and are the benediction for them but there are some challenging issues. The major problem of a programmer to memorize the syntaxes of different programming languages at the same time. It is very common among the programmers to mix up the syntaxes of different programming languages during coding. Moreover, the people who are suffering with Parkinson's disease cannot do programming because of their shaky hands. In additional, hand typing programming takes enough time to perform the coding. This study discusses how to reduce typing problems by hands, syntax memorization problems and time consuming problems during programming. However, the proposed system named VCL (Voice Command Language) is a very easy and time saving software. This software is capable of coding on multiple programming languages (such as Python, Java and C) by using same voice command against the syntax for all languages. Voice command is recognized by the Google Speech API and then software generate the code against the command. This software will help the programmers to focus more on logics rather than memorizing the syntaxes. The study will also help the programmers to speed up their programming performance and will create a new window for the hand injured people.

articleTitle: Clustering Text Using Attention
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Clustering Text has been an important problem in the domain of Natural Language Processing. While there are techniques to cluster text based on using conventional clustering techniques on top of contextual or non-contextual vector space representations, it still remains a prevalent area of research possible to various improvements in performance and implementation of these techniques. This paper discusses a novel technique to cluster text using attention mechanisms. Attention Mechanisms have proven to be highly effective in various NLP tasks in recent times. This paper extends the idea of attention mechanism in clustering space and sheds some light on a whole new area of research

articleTitle: Prediction of Diabetics Using Chemical Reaction Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Diabetes Mellitus (DM) is ordinarily conversant like diabetes that is a group of metabolic diseases. It has become a common disease and its degree and prevalence are becoming greater in degree in most inhabitants. Physicians want a reliable system for diagnosing diabetes. Many researchers have used many techniques to diagnose Diabetes. One of the recently established population-based metaheuristic algorithms is Chemical Reaction Optimization (CRO) for problem optimization, which generates from the concept of the nature of chemical reactions. In our study, the main goal of our paper is to find out the best result whether the patient has diabetes or not, using Chemical Reaction Optimization (CRO) with minimum features. We use five different classifiers such as Decision Tree, XGboost, Random Forest, and Support Vector Machine as our objective functions of CRO. We achieved the highest accuracy to predict diabetics compared to the existing methods with optimized features.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Dual Spilt-Ring Based Metamaterial Absorber
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In this paper, we have proposed an ultrathin perfect metamaterial absorber based on dual split-ring with a cross-resonator designed on an ultrathin low cost FR4 substrate with a thickness of 1.6mm (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{0.026}\lambda_{0}$</tex> corresponding to the resonant frequency) and unit cell size of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$8\times8\ \text{mm}^{2}$</tex>. The proposed absorber has 99.99% absorptivity at 5.02 GHz in C-band. The permittivity, permeability and normalized impedance have also been calculated to find the impedance matching of the proposed structure. The structure has also been analyzed by varying different design parameters. To study the effect the rotational angle of splits the proposed structure was rotated 45° clockwise and absorption response have been analyzed, the rotated structures have multiband absorption response in X-band and Ku-band.

articleTitle: Q Slot Terahertz (THz) Novel Antenna Design for Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper presents a Q slot novel Terahertz (THz) antenna design for wireless communications. The proposed antenna is a rectangular antenna made out of rectangular radiator and elliptical slot that fed by coaxial transmission line. The antenna works at dual bandwidth frequency groups in terahertz frequency spectrum. Over the century there was a huge development established in wireless technology but we are still searching for more improvement on this field. Wireless networking is one of the major research fields in the field of wireless technology. Today, communication systems and an analysis of communication systems are being carried out unfinished without an awareness of the process and produce of for antennas. This was the key reason for our work based on such a sector. People started to use infrared for over a century. Now a day's people have begun to use mm-wave in communication systems. But there is a frequency band between mm-waves and the infrared region called sub-mm-wave or terahertz in the electromagnetic spectrum that still unused in practical technology, producing and detecting radiation. It is classified as wavelengths of 3 mm to 10 μm from 0.3 to 30 THz. Useful power generation and receiver technologies are currently under development at frequencies within this range. The area of antenna research is extremely vast. The design and simulation of patch antennas is therefore our main focus. So we focus on optimization of a patch antenna feed by a 1 THz to 3 THz which got a rectangular probe and a Q-slot on it. We evaluate the configuration of the proposed antenna and determine its output in terms of return loss, bandwidth, gain, efficiency, and radiation patterns. The antenna is design and simulated by CST studio. Further testing and simulation is under development.

articleTitle: Social Networking Sites Data Analysis using NLP and ML to Predict Depression
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Depression is an acute problem throughout the world, where more than 264 million people are suffering from it. Due to worst and prolong depression near around 800000 people dies in every year. The real problem is that most of the people are not concern of the fact that they are suffering from depression. Here, our aim was to find out whether an individual is depressed or not by analyzing social media text information. Our dataset consists of 1500 sentences, which was collected from different social media platforms- Facebook, Tweeter, and Instagram. Then we have performed natural language based data pre-processing approaches such astokenization, remove of stop words, remove of empty string, remove of punctuations, stemming and lemmatizing. After data preprocessing, we considered processed text as input. We work on six different machine learning classifiers which produced great accuracy over our dataset. Among six algorithms, Multinomial Naive Bayes and Logistic Regression provided 95% accuracy.

articleTitle: Minimizing the Probability of Error in Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The growing demand for the spectrum has made it necessary to utilize the available resources in an efficient and sustainable manner. The cognitive radio (CR) system is an approach where the unutilized spectrum of primary user (PU) is used by the secondary user (SU). The SU compares PU signal with a threshold to detect the freely available channel. Thus, there is a need for an appropriate threshold. In this paper, we have find an optimum threshold by minimizing the probability of error. We have shown conventional approach where the sensing is done for τ units and data is transmitted for T-τ units while in the proposed approach both sensing and data transmission is being done for the entire frame time T using handshaking approach. Further, we have compared their performance parameters. It can be observed that under the condition of optimal threshold, the probability of error in the conventional approach is 0.14953 while it is reduced to 0.01485 in the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Tin Halide Perovskite Solar Cell using Solar Cell Capacitance Simulator
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Perovskite solar cells (PSC) are becoming increasingly popular owing to its elevated power conversion efficiency. Therefore, in this paper, tin halide perovskite solar cell which is non-toxic in nature is presented with the structure of Sn02:F|ZnSe | CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>SnI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>| CuO | Ni and numerically investigated using SCAPS-1D. In the reported PSC, fluorine-doped tin oxide (SnO2:F) is employed as transparent conducting oxide layer, zinc selenide (ZnSe) as electron transport layer (ETL), CH3NH3SnI3 as perovskite absorber layer, copper oxide (CuO) as hole transport layer (HTL) and nickel (Ni) as back contact. We evaluated the PSC performance by varying the thickness (350nm-450nm), acceptor density (3.2 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup>cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3-3.2</sup>x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sup>cm-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) and defect density (4.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sup>cm-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>- 4.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup>cm-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>) of perovskite absorber layer at temperature of 300K. In addition, the influence of the operating temperature on cell performance of tin halide PSC has studied. It has been demonstrated that, the presented tin halide PSC obtained maximum power conversion efficiency (PCE) 27.26%, open circuit voltage (Voc) 1.0222V, short-circuit current density (J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">sc</inf>) 31.94mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, Fill Factor (FF) 83.50% with the thickness (450nm), acceptor density (3.2×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup>) and defect density (4.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup>) of the tin halide perovskite absorber layer. The result of this numerical demonstration indicates that CH3NH3SnI3 has a great potential as an absorber layer of environment friendly PSCs.

articleTitle: An Object-Based Detection of Splicing Forgery using Color Illumination Inconsistencies
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)

authors.preferredName: P N R L Chandra Sekhar

abstract: This digital imaging era has become ingrained in people to share images and videos with their loved ones via social networking sites. On the other hand, photo editing software innovation allows anyone to easily and quickly modify multimedia content. As a result, people have become accustomed to alter digital content for the sake of amusement or to attract the attention of others. As a result, Digital Image Forensics emerges to provide trustworthiness to the content shared via the internet. This paper proposes efficient tampering detection and localization method for detecting splicing attacks using color illumination inconsistencies. First, the image's color illuminant features extract using the grayness index in rg-chromaticity space. The color illuminants of each color channel are then combined with a logistic regression model to reveal tampered objects in the image. The experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms the state-of-the-art.

articleTitle: Temporal Difference Learning Model for TCP End-To-End Congestion Control in Heterogeneous Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Conventional TCP end-to-end Congestion Control approaches cannot be applied directly to heterogeneous wireless networks as TCP is unable to distinguish the reason for the packet loss. The high error rates in wireless networks are due to interference or frame collisions caused by multiple simultaneous transmissions resulting in throughput degradation. There exist several ML approaches towards congestion control but neither the supervised nor the unsupervised learning techniques are suitable for learning the optimal policy. Therefore, a model is to be developed that predicts the optimal congestion window by interacting with the environment dynamically. To address these challenges, we propose a reinforcement learning model to dynamically adjust the congestion window using the Actor-Critic method and Temporal Difference learning. From the experiments, it is evident that the proposed learning model achieves 40% more throughput than the existing techniques while maintaining low transmission latency.

articleTitle: Automated Human Emotion Recognition and Analysis using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Detecting and recognizing human emotion is a big challenge in computer vision and artificial intelligence. Emotions are a big part of human communication. Most of the communication takes place through emotion. The main aim of our project is to develop a robust system which can detect as well as recognize human emotion from the live feed and also detect emotion from speech using NLP. There are some emotions which are universal to all human beings like anger, sadness, happiness, surprise, fear, disgust and neutrality. We have split the work into two modules. The first module is purely based on Video where the model classified different emotions of faces in a live feed. The second module analyses a text and detects the emotion in the text.

articleTitle: Test Set Generation for Multiple Faults in Boolean Systems using SAT Solver
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The detection of a stuck-at fault in the digital circuit requires a specific set of inputs, commonly known as test inputs. The fault detection problem is NP-complete, with a complexity of at least <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$O(2^{n})$</tex> for <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$n$</tex> faults. With an increase in the size of the circuit, and consequently the possibility of the number of faults, the generation of test inputs becomes computationally challenging. We have used the Boolean satisfiability (SAT) algorithm to deal with such complexity. MiniSAT 2.2 is a well-known SAT algorithm with a computational complexity of less than <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$O$</tex>(1.3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sup>). The result of this SAT problem was obtained with MiniSAT 2.2 algorithm and python platform. The results obtained were analyzed to determine the test sets for combinational circuits. Another advantage of this method is that it is helpful for the detection of single as well as multiple-simultaneous stuck-at faults, which are even harder to detect. The method has been developed by keeping in mind its possible application in biological circuits, like detecting genetic mutations.

articleTitle: Identification of Multiple Copy-move Attacks in Digital Images using FFT and CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Copy-move forgery is an image manipulation technique wherein significant elements are added or removed from the image to spread misinformation. These forged images have flooded the internet owing to easily accessible image editing software. Copy-move attacks distort edges around the manipulated elements and thus can be detected by analyzing these edges. Traditional detection methods utilize algorithms like Cosine Transform, Scale-invariant Feature Transform, and Convolution Neural Networks (CNN), which have varying levels of accuracy and fail when there are multiple copy-move attacks in the image. Since edge detection and analysis are critical steps, performing Preliminary Edge Detection on the images proves effective. This study proposes Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) to perform preliminary edge detection on the images used to train the CNN model. The proposed algorithm that combines FFT and CNNs achieves enhanced testing accuracy of 95.91%, low validation loss of 0.252, and performs exceptionally well with multiple copy-move attacks.

articleTitle: Linear Fusion of Multi-Scale Transmissions for Image Dehazing
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Images acquired in inclement weather conditions (haze, mist, fog, rain, etc.) suffer from various degradation problems such as low contrast, diminished visibility and color distortions. These low-quality images do not meet the demand for computer vision applications like object recognition, smart transportation, remote sensing, weather forecasting, etc. To restore the haze-free image, we require two parameters to estimate. The first parameter is an estimation of the transmission and second is the atmospheric light. Existing work focused on estimation of the transmission. However, two issues halo artifacts at the sudden change of the depth and over enhancement are unresolved in the dehazed image due to inaccurate estimation of the transmission. The traditional methods utilized two methods: pixel-wise and patch-wise while estimating the transmission. However, these two methods pixel-wise and patch-wise suffer from the problem of over-saturation or loss of details and halo artifacts in the dehazed images respectively. This paper suggests a linear fusion of multi-scale transmissions to overcome these problems. Experiments are performed on various hazy images and qualitative and quantitative results are presented. These qualitative and quantitative results reveal that the proposed method has successfully overcome these problems.

articleTitle: Impact of Deep Learning Models On Hate Speech Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Internet one of the mediums of connectivity that is available at the doorstep, with access to the internet one gets access to many web-based platforms. An increase in the use of these platforms gives us some benefits as well as some drawbacks. One of such drawbacks is hate speech. Hate speech is a topic of concern for social media platforms. With dynamically increasing datasets manual intervention of posts is quite impossible or will be time-consuming. Hate speech detection is an automated task to detect hate speech from the input. In this paper, we have compared some deep learning models like Convolution Neural Network (CNN), Recurrence Neural Network (RNN), Long Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), and Long-Short Term Memory. The datasets used here are publicly available. The result of our analysis shows us that GRU performed better than other basic deep learning models. The model achieved an accuracy of 92.60% with an F1 score of 81.84% for dataset (D1) and the respective values for dataset (D2) are 96.15% and 83.06%.

articleTitle: Fake News Prediction On COVID Dataset Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Fake news is false information, nowadays these are big challenges in all types of media, especially social media. In this covid-19 pandemic situation, people are facing more problems and struggling every day. One among those problems, is fake news or false information about covid. To tackle this, we have made an attempt and created a dataset with 4200 records from social media. We analyze the outbreak of covid information and visualize them using charts and graphs and predict the fake news using three classifier machine learning models. They are passive aggressive classifiers, Naïve Bayes classifiers and Support Vector Machines.

articleTitle: Learning from YouTube Videos using Drona Extension
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)

authors.preferredName: Chimakurthi N Sai Pavan Manikanta Chandu

abstract: There has been a boom in the use of online resources for education since the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic. Educational videos are an important part of these online resources and are very helpful to students. However, there are various issues related to the use of educational videos such as losing focus, lack of feedback to students, and taking notes manually while watching. The primary objective of this work is to design and develop an intelligent browser action chrome extension that generates smart notes and quizzes from educational YouTube videos. The extension will serve anyone learning from YouTube by providing a dynamic platform to grasp the content and assess themselves.

articleTitle: Intensified Biological Signature Recognition in the Wild: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The biological signature recognition seems to be a solved problem, but when these systems are tested in the wild their accuracy collapsed abruptly. A case study of “Face Recognition Through Camera (FRTC)” was designed to make a state of art for biological signature recognition in the wild system with minimum data set required to provide the highest accuracy. The FRTC system was designed by integrating the best qualities of modern recognition systems present in recent times (OpenCV and Face API) to intensify the biological signature recognition in the wild. The case study FRTC would be tested with the classroom attendance without prior information to the students. It was expected that FRTC would be more accurate than OpenCV and Face API. The results have shown the FRTC is more accurate, 7.02% and -1% than OpenCV and Face API respectively.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Multiple Supervised Learning Algorithms for YouTube Exaggerated Bangla Titles Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Exaggerated titles of YouTube videos are annoying. YouTube has been the most popular online video service for several years, with billions of subscribers and viewers. These videos have titles. To attract audiences, the YouTuber uses the most interesting words in the video's title. On YouTube, there are two types of titles: consistent and exaggerated. Usually, these exaggerated titles encourage people to watch videos but in reality, people don't get much entertainment by watching these exaggerated titles videos. To overcome this problem, we present a Bangla text classification analysis approach based on Natural Language Processing (NLP) on YouTube titles. We collect two different phases of video data on YouTube after watching so many videos. This classification assists in the discovery of YouTube videos with exaggerated titles. We used a total of six models in this research. Based on the results of research conducted, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has successfully classified the exaggerated Bangla title videos because it achieves results of 80%, 81.25%, and 76.47% for accuracy, precision, and F1 Score respectively.

articleTitle: Area Efficient Hardware Architecture of Skeletonization for 2D Images
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Thinning algorithms (TA) are commonly utilized to extract an object's functioning parameters. The skeletonization algorithm (SA) comprises of broad range of complex mathematics and involves lengthy implementations when dealing with real time (RT). Algorithms on hardware platforms can be applied to boost the efficiency of image processing applications. Reconfigurable equipment used as hardware module in the field of Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs) that can offer high performance with lower latency are being used for real world applications. FPGAs' inherent reprogramming capacity allows them application versatility while maintaining the efficiency benefits of a particular approach for an operation. Just real-time hardware devices can be used with fewer tools as in real-time implementations image sizes get larger. In the proposed architecture, the 8x8 image pixels are processed in one 3x3 window per clock cycle instead of one pixel per cycle. The proposed design shows significant reduction in area.

articleTitle: Balanced Graph Partitioning based I/O Intensive Virtual Cluster Placement in Cloud Data Center
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Distributed application deployment in a cloud environment has emerged as a new area of research in cloud computing. I/O intensive virtual machines form a virtual cluster, which requires a large volume of data transfer for communication among themselves. Cloud service providers manage huge infrastructural resources using standard hierarchical network topologies, like FatTree, VL2, etc. To achieve high throughput communication cost needs to be reduced. In this regard, efficient allocation of the cooperating virtual machines may reduce communication costs and delay without compromising total energy consumption by the active hosts of the data center. However, the objectives are conflicting with each other. This research proposes a novel balanced graph partitioning-based heuristic that reduces communication costs by allocating the cooperating VMs at proximity and energy consumption by consolidating the virtual machines in a minimum number of active hosts for reducing wastage of the active hosts, which in turn reduces the energy consumption of the data center.

articleTitle: A hybrid metaheuristic and machine learning algorithm for optimal task scheduling in cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The efficient scheduling of tasks in the cloud has been a challenging issue for years. Very high-performance computing can be achieved with optimal scheduling of tasks to available virtual machines in the cloud. Thus, in this paper, we propose a hybrid machine learning algorithm in which the input of the machine learning algorithm comes from the output of metaheuristics. A hybrid metaheuristic is used to overcome the drawback of one over the other. We have used hybrid Genetic Algorithm and Particle Swarm Optimization metaheuristic to overcome the local optima problem. This data is further fed to the Majority Voting Ensemble to train, so that in future any set of given tasks can be allocated to the given available virtual machines by the classifier in the most optimal manner. The experimental results reveal that the hybrid GA-PSO-MVE gives a better makespan, total execution time, and accuracy in comparison to many previously used approaches such as GA-ANN.

articleTitle: Link Capacity Division in P2P File Sharing System
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Optimal capacity partitioning in peer-to-peer (p2p) file sharing system has been a topic of discussion in recent years by many research scholars. In Various network like Wi-Fi, WLAN, LTE, and WiMAX, the access link capacity division between uplink and downlink can be modified by the peers. Each peer is allocated a link capacity by the network which can be used for uplink and downlink. This available link capacity can be judiciously divided between uplink and downlink in such a way that peers requirement is fulfilled while keeping the uplink minimum. The sum of uplink and download capacity is constant for fixed unit of time. So uplink and downlink capacity of each peer has been represented in terms of a variable. This paper aims to minimize the value of the variable such that uplink is minimum as well as requirement of each peer is fulfilled. In P2P file sharing system, the download requirements of the terminals have been described by a constant constraint system with addition-min relation inequalities. A linear programming approach is developed to find the minimum value of variable which makes the uplink minimum with satisfying the peers' requirement.

articleTitle: Design & Development of Fingerprint Based Electro-Magnetic Door Lock System
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Security can be a top challenge in our daily life. Perhaps the foremost critical utility of correct private identity is securing restrained get right of entry to structures from malicious attacks. Access gadget forms a critical link in a very safety chain. The fingerprint-primarily based totally safety gadget supplied right here is an get right of entry to gadget that permits handiest legal people to get right of entry to a confined area. we've applied a locker safety gadget supported via way of means of fingerprint, keypad, and electromagnetic lock generation containing a door locking gadget that might activate, authenticate, and validate the consumer and liberate the door for steady get right of entry to. The novelty of the proposed gadget compared to different door lock structures determined inside the literature evaluations is that it permits the gadget proprietor to edit delete upload customers for a couple of makes use of the locker gadget and simple operations normally determined in such a quiet gadget low cost.

articleTitle: Emergency Locket for Women using Blynk and IFTTT based on the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: In today's worldwide scenario women face various difficulties and the need to find a solution to this has become a major concern. Recent evaluations made by the World Health Organization indicated that nearly 30% of women worldwide have been exposed to some type of abuse or harassment. Hence, we proposed a solution to this by creating a smart locket that can be used very easily whenever they sense a threat. The locket is embedded with an ESP8266 microcontroller, pressure sensor, push button, and a buzzer and it assists with giving well-being to women effectively. When a troublesome situation occurs the press button or pressure sensor can be used to activate the device and the buzzer. Through the utilization of the Blynk application, we obtain the latitude and longitude based on mobile phone GPS, and a message, a voice call, and an email will be sent to the predefined contacts with the assistance of the IFTTT innovation in such circumstances. This new device based on the Internet of Things will lead to a safer environment for women.

articleTitle: Smart Agriculture using IoT & Filtering Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: This paper focuses on the idea of smart agriculture. The main idea of this project is to make a smart irrigation system that updates live data using Internet of Things(IoT) technology. IoT technology helps to retrieve data from the sensors such as Temperature, Humidity, Soil Moisture. All these sensor values will be accessible to the farmer through a web application. This web application helps farmers better understand the requirement of water content in the soil which will eventually help in better irrigation followed by better crop production. The web application comprises three display sections, each displaying temperature, moisture & humidity values, and a manual button has been included for scenarios when there is an abundance of water due to rainfall. In such cases, alerts will be generated and the farmer can dig a way for excess water removal. The temperature sensor values are further processed for filtering out the noise by performing the Kalman Filter technique using Processing IDE application by Arduino. After filtering the noise we get smooth values and these threshold values are passed into a decision tree algorithm which, based on its rules, decides whether the water pump should be switched on or off.

articleTitle: Counterfeit Currency Detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Currency is the backbone of a country's economy and banknotes are the primary form of currency used in the Indian Economy. Counterfeit currency is an imitation of a real currency with an idea to deceive. With advancement in technology the practice of counterfeiting currency has become more refined and circulation of such counterfeit notes gives a huge blow to the economy. Hence detecting them is of utmost importance. There exist many commercial techniques for fake note detection however they are not accessible by common man. Individuals who innocently acquire counterfeit currency are victimized and there are usually no government policies to reimburse them for counterfeit notes that are seized. This paper suggests a system that is deployable on smartphones and hence can be used by common people to check whether the possessed currency is fake or real.

articleTitle: DDOS prevention in IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Connecting anything to the Internet is one of the main objectives of the Internet of Things (IoT). It enabled to access any device from anywhere at any time without any human intervention. There are endless applications of IoT involving controlling home applications to industry. This rapid growth of this technology and innovations of its application results due to improved technology of developing these tiny devices with its back-end software. On the other side, internal resources such as memory, processing power, battery life are the significant constraints of these devices. Introducing lightweight cryptography helped secure data transmission across various devices while protecting these devices from getting attacked for DDoS attack is still a significant concern. This paper primarily focuses on elaborating on DDoS attack and the malware used to initiate a DDoS attack on IoT devices. Further, this paper mainly focuses on providing solutions that would help to prevent DDoS attack from IoT network.

articleTitle: Designing and Simulation a Reliable Standalone Solar/wind Hybrid System
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The high cost of solar photovoltaic systems, as well as the noise pollution and unpredictability of the wind energy, make them less appealing in areas with power grid access. However, in areas without access to the power grid, there is a strong desire to use renewable energy sources such as solar and wind energy systems. A photovoltaic (PV) system and a wind power system create DC and AC power, respectively. The primary issue with installing a PV system is that it cannot operate at night or on cloudy days when there is no sunshine to generate electricity. Furthermore, due of the wind's variability, the primary difficulty with wind energy is its lack of reliability. To address these issues, this paper proposes a hybrid solar/wind energy system that converts sunlight and wind energy into electrical energy. The output power of both energy sources is simulated using MATLAB Simulink.

articleTitle: Bottleneck HRV Features for Screening Sleep Apnea Disorder
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Sleep apnea; a respiratory sleep ailment, where individual feels sudden ceasing in their breath during sleep. This disorder if goes untreated can lead to several critical health disorders. Rural areas, who are often deprived of speciality systems, disorders like sleep apnea remains untreated. In this work bottleneck features (BNF) derived from a convolutional neural network (CNN) model has been used. BNF are efficient in extracting patterns from the input features. Initially a baseline CNN model was build using the time domain heart rate variability (HRV) features (TD) and frequency domain HRV features (FD) extracted from ECG signal. Subsequently a fully connected network was developed using the BNF extracted from respective CNN models. The TD-BNF model showed comparatively good performance with an overall accuracy of 78.27%, sensitivity of 76.01%, and specificity of 79.73%.

articleTitle: Disjoint Set Union for Trees
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: The Disjoint Set Union (DSU) for Trees can be used to solve a lot of problems. It is effective in solving problems of the type: How many vertices in the subtree of a vertex V are following a particular property? For an organization that follows a Hierarchical employee structure, the administration might want to know the number of employees working under Manager ‘M’ who belongs to city ‘C’? Conventionally such sort of problems is solved by considering every individual working under ‘M’ and then seeing how many of them belongs to city ‘C’, but when the number of such queries are high then following the conventional approach is not at all feasible as for each query in worst case it takes O(N) time where N is the number of employees in hierarchical structure and therefore for Q such queries time complexity will be O(N*Q). Such problems can be effectively solved using DSU for trees with time complexity O(Q +N* Log<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>(N)). DSU for Tree is based on the idea of effectively merging the Disjoint Sets. Disjoint Set Union for trees uses the same structure as used in graphs. For graphs, the structure has two methods: unite and getParent. Similarly, for trees the same two methods are applicable but their definition gets tweaked as per the applicability. To validate the performance some data sets are generated and solution involving DSU for trees and two other brute force approaches were executed and runtime of each approach suggests that DSU for Tree takes approximately (Log(N)/N) times the runtime of brute force approaches.

articleTitle: Secure Web Accessibility Protocol for Challenged Users
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: An unsolved problem in the domain of Internet Accessibility, which is a stream in Human Computer Interface (HCI), is how cognitively challenged or visually impaired users access a service. This paper proposes an assistive technology for disabled users in the form of a Randomized Authentication Gateway (RAG) mechanism corresponding to a challenge-pool. The challenge-pool contains different stand-alone Accessibility Protocols that are suitable for different situations. Holistically, we believe that the system works the finest when it is used as a single federated interface. The RAG manager picks up random challenges from the challenge-pool and the client, who is looking to access a particular service, is subjected to these challenges. If the client successfully completes them, he is authenticated as a valid user of the intended service. This paper discusses the audio-based, pressure-based and gesture-based mechanisms for seamless authentication of challenged users. We have defined this problem in terms of Accessibility Deficiency and Bot Indicator. The proposed system is only 23% accessibility deficient and covers the use cases of partially blind, completely blind, color blind and users suffering from diseases that affects their comprehension skills, like dyslexia. The research focuses on a keyboard-friendly environment where the fit or challenged users will have complete control over the interface using the one-click functionality. This work is our way to ensure that no restriction is imposed on any user while surfing through the internet.

articleTitle: A Curvature Based Approach for the Identification of Tortuous Blood Vessels in Retinal images of Preterm Infants
publicationTitle: 2021 12th International Conference on Computing Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT)
abstract: Retinal blood vessel tortuosity is an important signature for the diagnosis of many systemic and non-systemic diseases. It can be mild with no visual impairments or may become severe, leading to permanent blindness. Retinal fundus images captured using Retcam Ophthalmic Imaging Device are screened for checking the presence of tortuous blood vessels in preterm infants. The tortuosity seen in the retina of preterm infants contributes to the detection of Plus disease, a major indicator of Retinopathy of Prematurity. The conventional disease diagnosis procedure involves a trained expert manually inspect the amount of tortuosity present in the blood vessels by comparing it with a gold standard image. Manual inspections are often subjective and may lead to errors due to the lack of experience or mindset of the examining clinician. Hence, there exists a need for automatic screening of retinal blood vessels for evaluating their tortuous behaviour. This paper put forward a curvature-based technique to identify tortuous vessels in an infant retinal image. The proposed technique can be further extended for the diagnosis of Plus disease in preterm infants.
